description: Turn any air conditioner on or off, set its mode (cool, heat, fan_only, dry, heat_cool), and optionally its target temperature, in one call. The ACs are one-way infrared units with no state feedback, so ALWAYS use this script when the user wants an AC running in a mode or at a temperature; it powers the unit on in the requested mode before applying the temperature. If it stops with an error, no AC was changed: relay the error and ask the user which AC they meant.

ac_name.description: The AC to control, by name or room as the user said it, e.g. bedroom or living room

hvac_mode.description: Mode to put the AC in. Use cool for cooling, off to turn it off.

variables.ac: {% set q = ac_name | lower | replace("'","") | replace("the ","") %}{% set qt = q.split() %}{% set ns = namespace(best='', bestscore=0, tie=false) %}{% for e in states.climate %}{% set cand = ((e.name or '') ~ ' ' ~ (area_name(e.entity_id) or '')) | lower | replace("'","") %}{% set ct = cand.split() %}{% set s = namespace(score=0) %}{% for t in qt %}{% set hit = namespace(v=false) %}{% for c in ct %}{% if c.startswith(t) or t.startswith(c) %}{% set hit.v = true %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if hit.v %}{% set s.score = s.score + 1 %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if s.score > ns.bestscore %}{% set ns.best = e.entity_id %}{% set ns.bestscore = s.score %}{% set ns.tie = false %}{% elif s.score == ns.bestscore and s.score > 0 and ns.best != e.entity_id %}{% set ns.tie = true %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ '' if ns.tie or ns.bestscore == 0 else ns.best }}

then.stop: No single air conditioner matched "{{ ac_name }}". Available: {{ states.climate | map(attribute='name') | join(', ') }}. Ask the user which one they meant instead of claiming success.

if.value_template: {{ temperature is defined and temperature is not none and hvac_mode != 'off' }}
